resources.string: Choose Default or a named sandbox. This changes your draft only; save the Lite App settings to apply it.
Select a sandbox, then tap Apply sandbox to save the assignment. Site data stays in its original sandbox.
Expand a sandbox to name it, manage its Cookie policy, or view its Lite Apps. Naming and Cookie changes are shared by all apps in that sandbox.

First-party Cookie policy applies to every Lite App in this sandbox, including apps using website defaults. Changes take effect when an app resumes. Blocking Cookies does not delete existing site data. Third-party Cookie preferences remain specific to each app.
Apps in the same sandbox share site data for the same site. Different sandboxes keep site data separate. Renaming a sandbox or switching an app does not move or clear site data.
Your Lite App settings have unsaved changes.

Choose one older session for all apps in this sandbox. Fully close every Lite App in this sandbox, including all windows and background media, then reopen an app for the choice to take effect. No site data is copied or merged.
The source Lite App could not be identified; it may have been removed. This is a separate saved session.
Selected: %1$s. Fully close and reopen this sandbox to use this session. Data has not been copied.
Could not select this session. Choose an available session and try again.
This will clear cookies, cache, and site data for all Lite Apps in %1$s. You will be logged out of accounts in this sandbox.
Lite Apps in the same sandbox share login sessions. Tap to change.
Custom settings active. Options below apply only to this Lite App.
Using Global Settings. Tap here or any switch below to customize.
Custom settings enabled for this Lite App.
